scope: Recommendations for P1-P11 review; not authorization or a scientific freeze

population.Email: Approved Nazario phishing plus Enron legitimate and SpamAssassin ham; CEAS auxiliary only; native meanings still require primary-source evidence
population.Web: Zenodo 8041387 content-bearing Email-independent branch; full DOM baseline requires archived markup, not tag lists
population.PhiUSIIL: Separate U1-Ph; native 0 phishing, 1 legitimate; FILENAME excluded
population.UCI: Separate U1-UCI; numeric target meaning unresolved in primary documentation, no guessed mapping

identity: snapshot-original-position-sha256-v1; raw snapshot hash + source + original file + pre-filter CSV record position; no historical rank transfer

grouping.component_policy: Union of source-evidenced exact/near/template/campaign/domain relationships, with coverage and limitations explicit
grouping.mixed_target_components: retain conflicting observations in one unsplit group; report ambiguity
grouping.near_duplicate_note: Recommendation only, using Table 4.4 MinHash then exact refinement. Shared normalized word tokens; short inputs retain exact matching with disclosed unavailable near coverage. LSH can miss qualifying pairs; exact refinement does not prove exhaustive recall. The implemented exact-prefix join is an optional recall audit within a separately accepted budget. Budget failure aborts without partial groups. Source-evidenced template/campaign/domain relationships add edges where available, otherwise explicit limitations.
grouping.unmet_constraints: stop; no group splitting, seed search or fallback random split

exposure: exploratory_previously_exposed unless authentic custody evidence establishes an unexposed scope; new IDs do not reseal data

behavior.implemented_language_guard: declared English only; unknown/unsupported never assessed absence
behavior.untagged_Email_language_decision: Pending: freeze a source-supported tagging procedure or explicitly accepted language-unavailable handling; no corpus-wide English assumption
behavior.recommended_partial_policy_for_review: Supported if any qualifying indicator has valid evidence; Absent only after every relevant indicator is assessed; otherwise Unavailable. Preserve indicator-level unknowns. Requires P6 acceptance before implementation/use.
behavior.trust_references: Independent documented static references only; never per-record phishing labels or expert behavioral ground truth
behavior.locators: Half-open Python character offsets in named original fields; DOM source ranges where raw markup exists

dictionary.missingness: None retained; fold-local numeric median only for partially observed columns; all-missing training columns fail closed
dictionary.unavailable_source_families: Explicit P7 source-limited scope/dictionary decision; never call a three-column fixture the full baseline
dictionary.E2: Four canonical support values followed by four availability values
dictionary.E3: Exact E1 then E2 concatenation on matched IDs, targets, groups and folds
dictionary.U1: Explicit native source dictionary, no source/target/ID/group/partition/fold/FILENAME predictors; preserve -1 and 0 codes

experiment.inner_folds: Reuse remaining supplied development folds; retune within calibration cross-fits
experiment.failure_policy: nonconvergence, missing required inputs, class infeasibility or numerical failure aborts the exact run; no silent candidate removal
experiment.xgboost_tree_count_note: 500 is a recommendation filling the unspecified count, not a value claimed from Table 4.8
experiment.budget_recommendation: No large launch now. After no-fit inputs and the exact expanded configurations exist, authorize one immutable bounded run with computed fits/rows, CPU threads=1, explicit wall time, storage and artifact limits. Do not silently reduce the paper grids.

selection.implementation_representation: E3 for each content modality; independent U1 for each technical source
selection.delta_pr_justification: Proposed prospective one-point absolute AP practical-equivalence margin; requires researcher/adviser rationale and acceptance before results
selection.uncertainty_policy: stop on inconclusive equivalence or undefined bootstrap evidence; do not force a winner
selection.final_tie: simplicity then Logistic Regression preference only after preceding criteria
selection.srs_disposition: Embedded SRS requires measurement but supplies no numerical acceptance bounds. Explicit no-hard-limit disposition is a recommendation, not a claim that an unknown limit is zero or absent.

benchmark.aggregation: Record each outer selected model; conservative max p95/size and min throughput for family feasibility; process working set separately from model memory

final_boundary: No final calibrator, operational precision/recall target, risk thresholds, selected bundle, sealed-test claim or final evaluation authorized by this candidate
